646yf4t.bio: 646yf4t, pronounced Babyfat, is Oshawa, Ontario singer, songwriter and producer Zachary Simmonds. The younger brother of Daniel Caesar, he moved from production into his own genre-blurring blend of alternative R&B, punk and soul with the 2025 project Growing Pains before appearing on Caesar's Son of Spergy.

darryl riley.bio: Toronto native Darryl Riley is a Canadian R&B singer, songwriter and producer whose career stretches back to the city's early-2000s urban music scene. A UMAC-nominated artist and longtime collaborator with Kardinal Offishall, he has also worked with Choclair and toured nationally alongside major hip-hop acts.

dominique way.bio: Barrie-born, Toronto-based singer-songwriter Dominique Way is a Canadian indie-pop artist known for warm melodies, intimate storytelling and early-2000s pop influences. After studying music industry arts at Fanshawe College, she built momentum with releases including Sprig and Who Could Not Be Broken and signed with Cult Nation Records.

sajaa..bio: Montreal-raised singer-songwriter Sajaa. is an R&B and soul artist whose smoky jazz-inflected vocals and confessional writing draw on influences including Lauryn Hill, D'Angelo, Joss Stone and Amy Winehouse. Her independent catalogue includes the EPs Blurred Minds & Perspectives and Vivid Dreams & Intuitions.

stephen hero.bio: Stephen Hero is an East Coast Canadian rapper, songwriter and producer whose work combines alternative hip-hop with a raw working-class perspective. After beginning to record as a teenager, he developed a self-produced catalogue spanning rap, experimental music and live instrumentation, including releases such as Just Because and Let's Get It.
